CM.name: Droit de timbre gradué on the land title of an immovable bought (25 000 to 400 000 F by value)
CM.statute: CGI edition 2024 art. 585-586 (unchanged in the 2026 edition; the DGI circular on LF 2025 has no change to art. 586)
CM.doc: art. 585: deeds that must be registered and state a value but bear no proportional duty are subject to the graduated stamp duty, in particular land titles and land books (value of the immovable estimated by the land registrar), loan and credit agreements; art. 586: per copy, by the highest value stated: up to 1 M 25 000 F; 1-20 M 50 000; 20-50 M 75 000; 50-100 M 150 000; 100-500 M 250 000; above 500 M 400 000. Each purchase of an immovable is taken to give one land title valued at the higher of price and assessed value.
unsupported: one copy per deed; loan and credit agreements (art. 585) are not in the input
the dimension stamp duty due in addition (art. 587)

CM.name: CNPS family benefits, employer (7 % up to 750 000 F a month)
CM.statute: Décret n° 2016/072 du 15 février 2016 art. 2 a), 4, 7 (CNPS compilation 2022; rates 'revisable every two years' (art. 11): no later decree held, flagged)
CM.doc: art. 2 a): family benefits 7 % of contributory wages (general scheme incl. domestic staff; 5,65 % agricultural, 3,7 % private education); art. 4: on wages up to 750 000 F a month (9 000 000 F a year); the family-benefit and work-accident branches are borne by the employer alone.
unsupported: SMIG floor on the contributory wage

CM.name: CNPS old-age, invalidity and death pensions, employer share (4,2 % up to 750 000 F a month)
CM.statute: Décret n° 2016/072 art. 3, 4 (CNPS compilation 2022, flagged as above)
CM.doc: art. 3: pensions 8,4 % of contributory wages, 4,2 % borne by the employer and 4,2 % by the worker; art. 4: ceiling 750 000 F a month.
unsupported: the worker's 4,2 % (2100) is not modelled here

CM.name: CNPS work accidents and occupational diseases, employer (1,75 %, risk group A)
CM.statute: Décret n° 2016/072 art. 7-8 (CNPS compilation 2022, flagged as above)
CM.doc: art. 8: 1,75 % of wages for risk group A (low), 2,5 % group B, 5 % group C, on all remuneration less business expenses (no ceiling). Companies are taken to be in group A.
unsupported: risk groups B (2,5 %) and C (5 %): the risk class is not in the input
